IDS = { 1000, -- Master Signal ID, do not use this ID!
1, -- This is Signal ID, ex.: for bool signal - Pantograph Up
100, -- This is Signal ID, ex.: for numeric signal - Brake Position }
local index = 0
function onTick()
local MY_ID = property.getNumber("Cab ID")
local data = {}
data[1000] = input.getBool(32) and 1 or 0 -- Master Signal
data[1] = input.getBool(1) and 1 or 0 --ex.: bool sognal - Pantograph Up
data[100] = input.getNumber(1) --ex.: numeric signal - Brake Position
index = index + 1
if index > #IDS then index = 1 end
local param = IDS[index]
output.setNumber(1, MY_ID) output.setNumber(2, param) output.setNumber(3, data[param] or 0)
end

memory = {}
masterState = {} lastSeen = {}
tick = 0
function onTick()
tick = tick + 1
local source = input.getNumber(1) local id = input.getNumber(2) local value = input.getNumber(3)
lastSeen[source] = tick
if id == 1000 then masterState[source] = value end
local activeMasters = 0 local validMaster = nil
for cab,state in pairs(masterState) do
local alive = lastSeen[cab] ~= nil and tick - lastSeen[cab] < 60
if alive and state == 1 then activeMasters = activeMasters + 1 validMaster = cab end
end
local conflict = activeMasters > 1 local noMaster = activeMasters == 0
output.setBool(31, conflict) output.setBool(32, noMaster)
if activeMasters == 1 then
memory[id] = value
end
output.setBool(1, (memory[1] or 0) == 1) -- memory[n] - is value ID. Add more string with other ID for other signal :)
output.setNumber(1, memory[100] or 0) -- memory[n] - is value ID. Add more string with other ID for other signal :)
end
